tagline: The number and the part agree.
sector: Industrial and Manufacturing, wholesale distribution of elevator and electrical replacement parts
founded_place_size: Cleveland, Ohio; canonical context for the repeat-client series.
about: Girdermark Elevator & Electrical Supply is the repeat client for this benchmark series. The canonical client context is Cleveland, Ohio, and this commission covers phase 1: components photography and technical sheets.
audience: Working buyers aged 35 to 60 who have specified this class of part for twenty years and judge a supplier by whether the photography and the spec table say the same thing. They order by part number and hold us to the values printed beside it.
price_positioning: Mid to upper industrial. Parts run 400 to 9,000 dollars. The material has to read as trustworthy and technical, never as a consumer hardware brand and never as glossy marketing.
typography: A single clear grotesque for headings and part numbers, a plain, generously set text face for the long spec tables. Nothing decorative. Numbers must be legible at a glance and unmistakable one from another.
voice: Direct, factual, no adjectives we cannot stand behind. We state the number, the finish and the price and we stop. If something is wrong we say so before it prints.
brand_assets_status: We have no working brand files and no written guidelines. Our data sheets exist only as a flat press PDF the printer sent us last spring, and nobody here knows how it was built. Keep that sheet exactly as our customers recognise it. The palette and type notes above are our best account of the look, reconstructed for you, not a formal system.
values: Accuracy over polish. Availability. Honesty about what we stock and what a part will do. We would rather lose a sale than print a spec we cannot certify.
